caption_used: The character distribution in RoleplayPref is organized into three primary categories — Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, and Real Characters — with 13 subcategories in the outer ring. Virtual Characters occupy approximately 60% of the distribution and are subdivided into Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters, with Movie Characters forming the largest virtual subcategory. Real Characters comprise seven subcategories including Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers, with Musicians representing the largest real-character segment. Custom Characters occupy a small portion with no labeled subcategories.

raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: The figure is a concentric donut chart illustrating the distribution of character types in the RoleplayPref dataset, organized into three main categories: Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, and Real Characters, with 13 subcategories displayed in the outer ring. The inner ring contains three segments: Virtual Characters (light blue, ~60% of total), Real Characters (light green, ~35%), and Custom Characters (light pink, ~5%). The outer ring subdivides these: Virtual Characters are split into Comic Characters, Movie Characters (largest among virtual), Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters, all in shades of light blue. Real Characters are divided into Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians (largest among real), Actors, and Influencers, all in shades of light green. Custom Characters occupy a small segment with no further labeled subcategories. The chart includes text labels for each segment and subcategory, arranged radially around the chart, with no legend or percentage values inside segments. The segments appear visually ordered by size within each main category, with larger segments placed clockwise from the top.
raw_responses.English:
This donut chart visually represents the character distribution within the RoleplayPref dataset, categorized into three primary groups — Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, and Real Characters — with 13 distinct subcategories detailed in the outer ring. The central donut segment labeled “Virtual Characters” dominates the chart, occupying approximately 60% of the total and rendered in a solid medium blue; it is subdivided into five outer segments: Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters, all in varying shades of light blue, with Movie Characters appearing as the largest among these virtual subcategories. Adjacent to it, the “Real Characters” segment, shown in green, accounts for roughly 30% of the distribution and is further divided into seven labeled subcategories — Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers — each in a distinct pale green shade, with Musicians visually appearing as the largest among them. The smallest segment, “Custom Characters,” shown in pink, occupies approximately 10% and has no further subdivisions labeled in the outer ring. The chart does not include a separate legend, as all categories and subcategories are directly labeled on the chart; percentage values are not numerically annotated but can be estimated visually. No slices are exploded or offset, and the segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top, with Virtual Characters forming the largest contiguous block, followed by Real Characters, and then Custom Characters. The visual emphasis is on the hierarchical structure, with the inner ring denoting the main categories and the outer ring detailing their subcomponents.

raw_responses.German: DESCRIPTION: Das Diagramm visualisiert die Verteilung von Charakteren in der Rolle-Spiel-Datenbank RoleplayPref, gegliedert in drei Hauptkategorien — Virtual Characters, Custom Characters und Real Characters — wobei die äußere Ringebene insgesamt 13 Untersegmente aufweist. Die Hauptkategorie „Virtual Characters“ nimmt mit etwa 60 % den größten Anteil ein und ist in fünf farblich abgesetzte Untersegmente unterteilt: Comic Characters (hellblau), Movie Characters (hellblau, größtes Untersegment der virtuellen Kategorie), Teleplay Characters (hellblau), Novel Characters (hellblau) und Game Characters (hellblau). Die Kategorie „Real Characters“ umfasst sieben grünlich getönte Untersegmente: Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians (größtes Segment der realen Kategorie), Actors und Influencers. „Custom Characters“ ist als kleines rosa Segment dargestellt, ohne weitere Unterteilung oder Beschriftung der Untersegmente. Die Segmente sind im Uhrzeigersinn angeordnet, beginnend mit „Comic Characters“ oben, und die Prozentwerte sind nicht direkt im Diagramm vermerkt, sondern aus der visuellen Flächengröße abzuleiten; eine Legende ist nicht vorhanden, jedoch sind alle Segmente direkt mit ihren Bezeichnungen beschriftet.
